Field Descriptions

SAMPLES_PROCESSED

Number of 1-bit samples processed in current window (0-512). Used for window initialization and wraparound tracking. Pattern count is valid when this reaches 512.

TARGET_PATTERN

Current 1-bit target pattern being tracked (0 or 1). Hardware automatically selects the most common pattern. Read to identify which bit value is dominant.

PATTERN_COUNT

Current count of the most frequently occurring 1-bit pattern in the sliding 512-sample window. For good entropy, expect ~256 (50% of 512). Values >280 indicate potential bias. Compare to APT_PROPORTION_1BIT.LIMIT. Updates continuously as window slides. Widened to 16-bit to support full counter range.
